prompts.level_1: Identify the immediate traversal, looting, weapon, combat, ability, healing, revive, ping, or menu goal and retain visible targets or cover relations.
prompts.level_2: Describe the tactical sub-goal across the encounter, rotation, looting route, recovery sequence, or team-support action.
prompts.level_3: State the long-horizon match objective such as rotating, surviving, preparing, taking a fight, recovering, or completing a match phase.
prompts.continuity: Merge rotations, looting, combat, and recovery only when they form one tactical plan or encounter; split on a new fight, relocation objective, respawn/reset, lobby transition, or unrelated match phase.
